meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: Claude 会读取你的本地视频，提取音频并转成文字稿，然后根据内容设计并生成一系列带时间的图形卡片（如标题、数据标注、引语、画中画等），叠加在视频上，最后渲染成 MP4 输出，原视频画面保持不动。
howto.when: 当你说出“graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics”等关键词，或要求给视频“包装/打扮”时触发；纯字幕需求不归它，不确定时会转到 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这段访谈视频加上动态标题和左下角人名条。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的图形卡片并渲染成新视频。

say.text: 把视频里提到的数据用大字报卡片标出来。
say.note: Claude 会识别数据时间点并设计数据卡片叠加。

say.text: 给这个播客视频设计几张引语卡片，配画中画。
say.note: Claude 会依据文字稿生成引语和画中画卡片。

howto.what_en: Claude reads your local video, extracts audio, transcribes it, then designs and generates a sequence of timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP) synced to the transcript, overlays them on the untouched original video, and renders the result to MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "graphic overlays" or "on-screen graphics", or ask to "package / dress up" your video. Plain subtitles are not included; unclear cases route through /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add animated titles and a lower-third name bar to this interview video.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the cards and render a new video.

say_en.text: Highlight the data points mentioned in the video with big callout cards.
say_en.note: Claude will locate data moments and design overlay cards.

say_en.text: Design a few quote cards for this podcast video with picture-in-picture.
say_en.note: Claude will create quote and PiP cards from the transcript.
